acceptance.note: Candidate S plus its two references must never truncate. T and historical H remain diagnostics, never substitutes. Observed inputs.

resourceObservations.note: 30-second read-only samples during the runner, excluding setup and backup-only time. Observed maximum is not a continuous peak.

limitations: All 1040 inputs are previously observed development diagnostics, not independent acceptance.
One seed and fixed order; no replicate-based generalization or speed significance claim.
H outputs and timing are historical. HF uses server CUDA; GGUF uses server CPU, not a phone benchmark.
Guarded safety is separate from incremental utility beyond deterministic parsing.
Twenty private originals and derivatives were excluded from training and diagnostic evaluation.
S is preselected; T cannot replace it. A development pass alone does not authorize native release.

transport.mode: Operational lossless transport only; no model bytes or scientific protocol changed.
transport.initialFullSourceUpload: Stopped after a stalled connection; partial retained. No model launch preceded verified source installation.
transport.controlWeightTransport: All four fresh remote hashes equal v4. Existing local full files reused only after hashing their actual bytes.
transport.candidateWeightTransport: Lossless XOR plus gzip against the verified control files; source, payload and complete reconstructed target SHA-256 checked.
transport.timingLimit: Concurrent lossless staging and fixed inference order may affect timings. Server CPU inference is not a phone benchmark.

costProxy.note: Conservative opening proxy through verified OFF, not platform billing time or an invoice.
